comment: Retain automatic-maintenance custody and headless first-touch interpreter/installer handoff with explicitly bound, concurrently forwarded native output and visible failure status; preserve manual-update project context and original typed source/project across self-staged teardown; route native Worktrees uninstall through the authenticated execution owner, canonical broker removal and finite teardown with external Python 3.11+; qualify exact staged publisher ancestry without exempting unrelated consumers; remove stale consumer source shadows and the duplicate Codespaces snapshot key; qualify real cold construction and serialized maintenance in disposable Windows CI.
